evidence: Homepage lists 8 heritage items (春节, 端午龙舟, 剪纸, 京剧, 昆曲, 书法, 苏绣, 宜兴紫砂) each with image, category, title, region, description, and detail link.
Clicking 了解详情 on 春节 and 昆曲 cards navigated to /heritage/spring-festival and /heritage/kunqu-opera dedicated detail pages.
Detail page for 春节 shows title, English subtitle, region badge (北京 · 华夏大地), inscription year (2006年入选), full description paragraph, and an image gallery with 3 thumbnails.
Category combobox lists 传统工艺/传统表演/民俗活动/传统美术; selecting 传统工艺 filtered list from 8 to 2 items (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂). Search box filtering and sort-by-year also verified to reorder/filter results correctly.

1) Opened 苏绣 hotspot overlay in panorama, navigated to its detail page, went back — overlay and hotspot state fully restored. 2) Zoomed in panorama (scale 1→1.2) then dragged to rotate (rotateX -9deg, translateX -37.65px) — zoom scale persisted through rotation. 3) Applied search filter '昆曲' on homepage, opened detail page, went back — search text and filtered result list were preserved.
Panorama view showed progressive loading prompt "正在加载热点... (2/8)" while hotspots loaded. Detail page for 春节 displayed "图片加载失败" fallback message with icon over the primary image that failed to load.

All 8 items carry a valid category tag: 民俗活动 (春节, 端午龙舟), 传统美术 (剪纸, 书法), 传统表演 (京剧, 昆曲), 传统工艺 (苏绣, 宜兴紫砂) — each falls within crafts/folk customs/performing arts (or closely related visual-arts subtype).

Valid item links (e.g. /heritage/spring-festival) navigate to full detail content. Navigating directly to an invalid slug (/heritage/nonexistent-item) shows "未找到该非遗项目" with a 返回首页 link instead of rendering a fake detail page.
Every list card includes title (e.g. 苏绣), description paragraph, and region (e.g. 江苏 · 江南水乡); detail pages additionally show inscription year.

List view uses a grid of compact cards with thumbnail+badge+title; detail view uses a distinct layout with breadcrumb nav, large hero image gallery, category badge, heading, region/year metadata, and full description — clearly distinguishable interface states.

All 8 exhibited items (春节, 端午龙舟/Dragon Boat, 剪纸/Paper Cutting, 京剧/Peking Opera, 昆曲/Kunqu Opera, 书法/Calligraphy, 苏绣/Suzhou Embroidery, 宜兴紫砂/Yixing Purple Clay) are real, well-documented Chinese intangible cultural heritage items with plausible regional origins and UNESCO/national inscription year (2006) consistent with historical record.
